text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
During our final days at summer<n>camp, Zenno Rob
Roy trains diligently<n>under the hot sun.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she lets out a deep breath, I<n>wonder if the
fatigue from these last<n>few days is getting to her. If
that's<n>the case...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry! It was just a little<n>sigh... But I'm all
right. I can keep<n>going—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My times... They've gotten<n>worse than I
thought.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her balance has started wavering<n>when she
pushes off the ground,<n>leading to erratic times even
for basic<n>running exercises.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uh, but really, I'm not tired at all. I still<n>have plenty
of stamina, so—
choice_data_list: Even heroes rest sometimes, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes... you're right. We do have to<n>reinvigorate
ourselves occasionally.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She has a point though—this amount<n>of training
shouldn't be too much.<n>Perhaps her fatigue is more
of a<n>mental issue.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me of something I heard<n>from the
locals. Apparently there's a<n>breathtaking spot
nearby to watch<n>fireworks from.
choice_data_list: I wonder if that would help...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The fireworks are tonight. I should go<n>check out the
spot beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Where could Trainer have gone? I've<n>had no luck
searching the rooms...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I wanted to explain that I'd do a<n>better job
tomorrow... I wasn't<n>concentrating as well as I
should<n>today.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(My mind was preoccupied the whole<n>time... about
how I might be forcing<n>Trainer to live up to my
idealized<n>vision.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's considerate and works<n>hard. That's
definitely true, and it<n>should be enough... Trainer is
already<n>a wonderful person, but I...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I made assumptions... and said<n>things I shouldn't
have. What if<n>Trainer is trying to become a different
person because of that?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Not here either...

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Colleague
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're my pal's trainee, aren't<n>you? It's the
weirdest thing, but they<n>forgot their phone in the
cafeteria, so<n>no one can contact them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Colleague
text_block_list.text:
Someone said they saw them<n>heading into the
mountains, but it<n>couldn't be, right? There's no
reason<n>to just go there randomly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-to the mountains, you say? But it's<n>already dark
out. Oh no... If that's<n>true, then maybe right at this
very<n>moment...

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... If I can just cross thisrope bridge... I should make it back toZenno Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Oh no, I'm losing my footing!<n>Aaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: No, Trainer! Agh, what do I do?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Colleague
text_block_list.text:
Oh wait, sorry. You know what, they<n>might've just
fallen asleep<n>somewhere. You know what your
trainer's like—always staying up late<n>looking over
your runs.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Colleague
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they got inspired by that<n>manga I lent 'em.
It's a pretty good<n>read.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, did you say manga? Could you<n>be referring to...
those large volumes,<n>as thick as textbooks?

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Colleague
text_block_list.text:
Those are the ones! Yeah, it's an<n>educational
series—all about training,<n>medical care, that kind of
stuff. But<n>presented as a manga to make it<n>easy to
read, you know?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's about training and medical care?

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Colleague
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, and your trainer was talking<n>about joining
a gym. Something about<n>trying new training
methods there<n>before applying them in your
routines?

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Colleague
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer's all in when it comes to<n>you. It's
impressive.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Still nothing... Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's fine. It's all right. Trainer is<n>an adult who
can handle just about<n>anything.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(And we promised. We have to finish<n>my heroic
chronicle together. So... so<n>I'm sure...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. I'm not forcing my<n>assumptions this
time. I'm sure of it...<n>because...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: We... trust each other!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Traineeer! Please, answer<n>me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah! ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness! I've finally found<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy is standing over me<n>with a troubled
look on her face... It<n>seems like I tired myself out
walking<n>here and ended up falling asleep.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I came here hoping to make her<n>happy, but I only
ended up causing<n>grief.
choice_data_list: I guess I'm still nowhere near your ideal.
I guess I'm still nowhere near your ideal.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...That's not true! Trainer, you're<n>perfectly fine, just
as you are! I<n>shouldn't have said what I did...
choice_data_list:
It's kind of my dream now to become what you
hope for.

It's kind of my dream now to become what you
hope for.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uh... What? Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(What I... what I hope for... No way!<n>But that's...
W-wait... I've got to calm<n>down!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Inhale, exhale... So, uh... Um, Trainer...what were you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After worrying her like this, I should<n>just say it. I
explain about the<n>fireworks and how I wanted to
show<n>her a beautiful sight to pick up her<n>spirits.
choice_data_list: I wanted to make you happy. That's all...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh... But it's my fault—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A burst of fireworks suddenly cuts<n>off her words.
Amidst the enveloping<n>sound, she opens her mouth
to speak<n>again.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No. You... did it to help me. Right?<n>That's... who you
are, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For a brief moment, the sky turns<n>quiet, and the
soothing laps of the<n>waves reach our ears. Zenno
Rob Roy<n>begins to smile softly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're already my ideal<n>person. You're
kind, hardworking,<n>and...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You're an irreplaceable partner for a<n>hero... You're
a generous person,<n>whom I always want to cherish.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The last firework goes up and lights<n>the sky,
painting Rob Roy's face in<n>dazzling colors.
